lesson.intro: El subjuntivo ingles sobrevive sobre todo en dos sitios: tras verbos y adjetivos de peticion / importancia (I suggest that he be..., It is essential that it be...) y en formulas fijas (be that as it may). Junto a el, este tema repasa como subir el registro: lexico latino, nominalizacion, pasiva impersonal y cautela (hedging).

sections.heading: 1 - Subjuntivo mandativo
sections.body:
Tras verbos de peticion, recomendacion o exigencia (suggest, recommend, insist, demand, require, propose, request, ask, order) + that + sujeto + verbo en forma base, para todas las personas y tiempos.

Negativa: that he not do... (sin do not). Es mas frecuente en ingles americano.
examples: I suggest that he be more careful.
They demanded that the CEO resign.
We ask that visitors not smoke.
The judge ordered that the documents be released.

sections.heading: 2 - Subjuntivo tras adjetivos
sections.body: Con adjetivos de necesidad o importancia (essential, vital, important, imperative, crucial, necessary, advisable) en la estructura It + be + adjetivo + that + sujeto + verbo base.
examples: It is essential that every form be complete.
It is vital that he meet the deadline.
It is imperative that nothing be overlooked.
It is crucial that the report be submitted on time.

sections.heading: 3 - La alternativa con 'should'
sections.body:
En ingles britanico es habitual usar should + base en lugar del subjuntivo puro: I suggest that he should go.

En registro informal tambien se dice simplemente I suggest that he goes / I suggest he goes. Aqui should no significa 'consejo': es solo un marcador.
examples: It is essential that she should be present. (BrE)
I suggest that he go now. (AmE formal)
I suggest he goes now. (informal)
They insisted that we should stay for dinner.

sections.heading: 4 - Subjuntivo fosilizado
sections.body:
Expresiones fijas donde el subjuntivo ha quedado "congelado":

  • God save the Queen; Long live the King
  • Be that as it may (= aun asi)
  • Come what may (= pase lo que pase)
  • Suffice it to say (= baste decir)
  • Far be it from me to...   If need be   So be it
examples: Be that as it may, we must proceed.
Come what may, I'll be there.
If need be, we can meet on Sunday.
Suffice it to say, it was a disaster.

sections.heading: 5 - 'were' subjuntivo
sections.body:
Se usa were para todas las personas en situaciones hipoteticas o irreales: If I were you; I wish I were; as if / as though + were; Suppose / Imagine + were.

were to + infinitivo anade un matiz mas remoto o tentativo. En habla informal se oye was, pero la escritura formal prefiere were.
examples: If I were you, I'd take the job.
I wish I were there.
He acts as if he were in charge.
If I were to accept, everything would change.

sections.heading: 6 - Lexico formal
sections.body:
El registro formal prefiere verbos de origen latino a los phrasal verbs y coloquialismos: obtain (get), require (need), commence (start), request (ask for), assist (help), purchase (buy), enquire (ask), ascertain / establish (find out), approximately (about), sufficient (enough).

Evita contracciones (do not, it is). Usa la nominalizacion (decide → decision, reject → rejection).
examples: We require your identification. (need)
The meeting will commence at 10. (start)
Please assist the new members. (help)
The committee's rejection of the proposal was final.

sections.heading: 7 - Estructuras formales
sections.body:
• Pasiva impersonal para informar: It is said / believed / understood / thought that...; He is said to be...
  • Hedging (cautela): It would appear that...; The evidence suggests that...; may / might / seem.
  • whom tras preposicion (to whom, for whom).
  • shall de obligacion en contratos (The tenant shall pay...).
  • Conectores cultos: consequently, hence, thus, moreover, notwithstanding.
examples: It is believed that the plan will fail.
He is thought to be a genius.
It would appear that there has been an error.
The person to whom I wrote has not replied.

sections.heading: 8 - Elegir la forma y el registro
sections.body:
Tras suggest / recommend / insist / demand + that: verbo en forma base (AmE), o + should (BrE), o forma normal (informal).

Tras It is essential / vital / imperative that: forma base.

En hipotesis: were para todas las personas.

Para subir el registro: quita contracciones, cambia phrasal verbs por verbos latinos, usa It is + participio + that y conectores cultos.
examples: I suggest that he go now. (formal) / I suggest he goes. (informal)
If I were you... (formal) / If I was you... (informal)
I wish to obtain... (formal) / I want to get... (informal)

contrast.title: Registro informal -> formal
rows: It would appear that there is an error.

mistakes: NO: I suggest that he goes to hospital. (AmE formal) -> SI: I suggest that he go to hospital.
NO: It is essential that everyone is informed. -> SI: It is essential that everyone be informed.
NO: We ask that visitors do not smoke. -> SI: We ask that visitors not smoke.
NO: If I was you... (escritura formal) -> SI: If I were you...
NO: aqui 'should' significa 'ought to'. -> Cuidado: aqui 'should' es solo un marcador de subjuntivo, no un consejo.
NO: The person to who I spoke. -> SI: The person to whom I spoke.
NO: Be that as it is, we must go on. -> SI: Be that as it may, we must go on.
